description: On a checkpoint resume the intent text is refreshed from the intent file into context.intent_data only. The checkpoint holds the intent goal in a second place, context.stage_results.intent.payload.intent.goal, which stays stale, so a resume can still run stages against a goal that predates the self-explaining-code sentence.
goal: In sandbox_executor/intent_refresh.py, make refresh_intent_text refresh, or derive from the refreshed intent data, the goal held in context.stage_results.intent.payload.intent.goal in the same resume path that refreshes context.intent_data, so both goal copies match the intent file after a resume. A checkpoint with no intent stage result, or one whose payload has no intent goal, resumes as before. The existing refusal of a goal without the self-explaining-code sentence is unchanged. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Both checkpoint copies of the goal must follow the intent file, or the review loop and executor judge the diff against a stale goal that drops the invariant.
acceptance_criteria: The checkpoint holds the intent goal in two places: context.intent_data.goal and context.stage_results.intent.payload.intent.goal. A fix must refresh both (or derive one from the other) when a resume re-reads the intent file.
Refresh (or derive) context.stage_results.intent.payload.intent.goal in the same resume path, with a test on a checkpoint whose stage_results goal lacks the sentence.

A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_intent_refresh_on_resume.py resumes a real checkpoint whose context.intent_data.goal and context.stage_results.intent.payload.intent.goal both predate the intent file (neither holds the self-explaining-code sentence) and asserts both goals equal the intent file's goal after refresh_intent_text in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/intent_refresh.py.
A test in the same file asserts a checkpoint with no intent stage result still refreshes context.intent_data without error.
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' passes.
